self_intro_assets.one_line_pitch_ja: 軽量モデル設計・物体検出・高速推論を強みとする、CV/ML志向の研究開発人材。
self_intro_assets.one_line_pitch_en: CV/ML-focused researcher-engineer with strengths in lightweight models, object detection, and fast inference.
self_intro_assets.short_bio_ja: コンピュータビジョンと機械学習を基盤に、軽量モデル設計、物体検出、高速推論、画像処理の研究と実装に取り組んできました。エッジデバイス向け物体認識アルゴリズムの学習・評価・軽量化を経験し、最近は LangGraph・LlamaIndex を用いた agent 関連タスクや LLM・マルチモーダル情報処理にも関心を広げています。
self_intro_assets.short_bio_en: I have worked on research and implementation in computer vision and machine learning, with strengths in lightweight model design, object detection, fast inference, and image processing. I also gained experience in training, evaluating, and compressing object-recognition algorithms for edge devices, and have recently expanded my interests toward agent-related tasks using LangGraph and LlamaIndex, as well as LLM and multimodal information processing.
